name: Jeff Merkley

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Merkley lists his occupation as U.S. Senator for Oregon.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition)

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists prior government experience as a state representative and Oregon House Speaker.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition)

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists past work with Habitat for Humanity, as a national security analyst and as a small business founder.
bio.excerpt: Habitat for Humanity; National Security Analyst; Small Business Founder

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition)

bio.statement: His official Senate biography says he was the first in his family to graduate from college, in 1979.
bio.excerpt: In 1979, he became the first person in his family to graduate from college.

source.publisher: Office of U.S. Senator Jeff Merkley

positions.statement: Merkley's pamphlet statement calls for ending stock trading and the exchange of government favors for investments in the president's companies.
positions.excerpt: No more stock trading; no more exchanging government favors for investments in Trump's companies.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition)

positions.statement: Merkley says he wants to stop gerrymandering, require paper ballots and end secret campaign funding.
positions.excerpt: Stop gerrymandering. Require paper ballots. End secret campaign funding.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition)

positions.statement: Merkley proposes banning hedge funds from buying single-family homes.
positions.excerpt: Ban hedge funds from buying single-family homes.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition)

positions.statement: Merkley says he would stop drug companies from price gouging.
positions.excerpt: Stop drug companies from price gouging.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition)

positions.statement: Merkley proposes affordable daycare and debt-free trade school and college.
positions.excerpt: Create affordable daycare and debt-free opportunities for trade school and college.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition)

positions.statement: Merkley calls for a rapid transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy, which he describes as cheaper and cleaner.
positions.excerpt: Rapidly transition from dirty, expensive fossils to cheaper, cleaner, renewables.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition)

voting_record.statement: Merkley voted Nay on Senate passage of H.R. 1, the budget reconciliation bill, on July 1, 2025 (Senate roll call vote 372).
voting_record.excerpt: On Passage of the Bill (H.R. 1, as Amended) … Merkley (D-OR), Nay

voting_record.statement: Merkley voted Nay on Senate passage of S. 5, the Laken Riley Act, on January 20, 2025 (Senate roll call vote 7).
voting_record.excerpt: On Passage of the Bill (S. 5, As Amended) … Merkley (D-OR), Nay

collection_notes: Steps 4-6 (open-web and T3 press searches) could not be completed for every candidate because the WebSearch budget shared by all agents in this run ran out (searches marked 'blocked' in collection_log were not run); searches that did run produced no items that were used. To keep effort equal, no T3 items are included for any candidate in the US Senate, US House 1-6 or Governor races: every item comes from the T1 voters' pamphlet, official .gov pages or official roll-call pages. Campaign websites are recorded from the pamphlet but were not fetched for positions, for any candidate. oregonlive.com and apnews.com are rejected by the search proxy as allowed_domains and could not be searched for anyone. Incumbency: pamphlet occupation 'U.S. Senator for Oregon' and merkley.senate.gov. congress.gov is robots-blocked for WebFetch, so roll calls cite senate.gov. Nominated by Democrat and Working Families per pamphlet; matches inventory.
